_readme: Keys exempted from the numeric-sequence check, each with a reason.
The validator normally fails a run when a figure in the English is
missing from a translation, because a dropped number in a factual
sentence makes a stated fact false. A few figures legitimately stop
being figures in translation -- '#1 most-used' becomes 'the most used',
'10th anniversary' becomes 'décimo aniversario'. The claim is unchanged;
Those keys are named here ONE AT A TIME with a written reason, so each
exemption stays a deliberate decision rather than a blanket loosening.
Exempt keys still print their mismatch on every run -- they just don't
fail it. Do not add a key here to silence a real dropped figure.
Every entry below was reviewed against the English source, not against
factoid_054: English '#1 most-used'; all five languages render it as 'the most used' with no numeral. Rank claim unchanged.
factoid_097: English says 'COVID-related'; translations expand it to the disease's full name, COVID-19, adding a 19 the source never had. Factually correct expansion.
factoid_099: English '10th anniversary'; Spanish spells the ordinal as 'décimo'. Same anniversary.
